name: Genosyn
notes: Open-source platform for scheduled "AI Employees" across finance, email, repositories, revenue, marketing and operations that hand decisions to a human past set thresholds. Self-hosted in one Docker container or on a hosted cloud, so on the board as a stretch product. Requested via the form (issue #169).
tagline: Your company can now run automatically.

access.price: Free self-hosted (Apache-2.0); cloud Free for 1 AI Employee, Growth $19 and Scale $49 per AI Employee/mo; bring your own model key
